title: rosa canina var. marginata
intro: Rosa canina var. marginata, commonly known as the red dog rose, is a variant of the wild rose plant native to Europe and Western Asia. This plant is known for its numerous health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and exhibiting antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Rosa canina var. marginata include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties, making it useful for wound healing and skin issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
